_comment: Configuration of runtime/testing/suite.py (contract: runtime/testing/README.md). One file per suite and line; the case versions it next to its suite. Fictional example: the Acme Orders product, line 2.1, a back-end part and a front-end part. Per-machine values (me, machine, stateDir, watch.drafting) go in <stateDir>/local.json or on the command line, never here.

suite.name: orders
suite._comment: marker: a file whose presence proves the suite is in this working copy (the stale check asks the head of the line when it is not). Results and logs go to a folder the VCS ignores: an untracked file makes the copy dirty and the baseline is refused.

paths._comment: Regular expressions over paths relative to the working copy, forward slashes. A test path wins over an untestable one.

gate._comment: warn until a numbered project decision turns the door blocking (EK#6)

agent._comment: The proposal agent, headless. Placeholders: {prompt} {proposal} {bundle} {rev} {agent_settings}. Its working folder is the proposal folder; the brief arrives on stdin here. Check the flags against your agent's version.
